key_points: Cisco reported 18% revenue growth and $9.3B AI orders, but shares fell 9% on Oct 7.
Analysts note AI-driven growth prospects, with new Dialog AI helper product and Supermicro server partnership.
Multiple small institutional trades show mixed buying and selling, no major position changes.
Price targets raised by some analysts, citing potential new growth phase.
Overall market reaction suggests near-term skepticism despite upbeat AI narrative.
